title: Vibe coding my way to a healthy family: Introducing Gamow Labs
summary: A personal blog post where the author documents their journey of using 'vibe coding' (AI-assisted rapid development) to build Gamow Labs while maintaining a healthy family life. The post appears to be a maker's diary exploring the balance between building a startup and family commitments.
problem_solved: Explores how AI tools can enable solo developers or small teams to build products faster while maintaining work-life balance.
why_valuable: Offers real-world insights into the practical application of AI-assisted development methodologies and the mental shift required when coding with AI.
